name: colon-any
description: The `: any` type ANNOTATION is the uncounted sibling of the ratcheted `as any` cast (audit F-06-1). `: any` on a tenant key (organizationId), a money value, an auth field, or external input erases the type checker exactly as `as any` does — the leads.organizationId-widening class the as-any ratchet exists to stop, walking straight past it because that ratchet only matches the `as any` cast form. This freezes the annotation count over server/ and drives it DOWN. Remediate the tenant-key/money/auth subset first; lower baselineCount as annotations are typed away. New `: any` now fails CI.
lastBumpNote: 3011 -> 3009 on 2026-08-13: the beta rail, deleted (BLOCKERS B15, founder ruling). The two annotations were `catch (err: any)` in routes-beta.ts's public waitlist handlers, and the erasure is what let them answer as if the write had landed: `joinWaitlist` pushes onto a module-level array — no table, no migration — so a public signup returned a queue position that died at the next deploy and was split across machines before that. `server/services/betaProgram.ts` went with it; the six founder-gated admin endpoints read only what the public POST wrote, so with the writer gone they were a console over a permanently empty set. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 3014 -> 3011 on 2026-08-13: the divergent founder shim in routes-beta.ts, deleted. Its signature was `function isFounder(req: any, res: any, next: any)` — three untyped params on an AUTHORIZATION middleware, which is where the erasure mattered: an Express middleware typed as `any` does not have to resemble RequestHandler, so nothing objected when it answered 403 (the repo's convention for founder surfaces is 404, stated five times in routes-admin.ts) or when it read only FOUNDER_EMAILS and missed FOUNDER_EMAIL and FOUNDER_USER_IDS. Replaced by the canonical requireFounder. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 3016 -> 3014 on 2026-08-12: VA task persistence refusal. The two `(req: Request, res: Response)` handlers for POST /api/va/tasks and PUT /api/va/tasks/:id now take `_req` and refuse with 501 — they returned a task-shaped 200 for a create that stored nothing (createTask is a pure function; VA_TASKS_KEY is declared and never used). The annotations went with the bodies that lied. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 3017 -> 3016 on 2026-08-12: VA escalation delivery. The `const escalations: any[]` annotation is gone now that the field is declared in its column's own $type<>. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 3018 -> 3017 on 2026-08-12: VA workflow bounds. The `const workflows: any[]` annotation on the va_workflows read is gone now that the field is declared in the column's own $type<> — the array is typed by the schema. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 3019 -> 3018 on 2026-08-09: developer-vertical Stage 1 extraction. The `threshold?: any` annotation on routes-lot-pricing.ts's inline evaluateRules moved into the pure @shared/subdivision/lotPricing engine and was retyped to `number | string | boolean` (the lot_pricing_rules.rules schema type), so the annotation is gone from server/. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule.
